# Figma components

15 components selected from the web Design System for genuine reuse, plus 4 patterns. This is a **specification**: no component was created in Figma. Every variable named below exists in [../../02-Design-Variables/Figma-Variables/collections.md](../../02-Design-Variables/Figma-Variables/collections.md) (validated).

| Component | Web equivalent | Priority | Variant properties | Variants | Booleans | Text | Instance swaps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Button](#button) | `.btn, .btn--primary, .btn--secondary, .btn--text` | core | Variant, Size, State | 45 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| [Icon Button](#icon-button) | `.icon-btn` | core | State, Selected | 10 | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| [Input Field](#input-field) | `.field, .input, .select, .textarea` | core | Type, State | 12 | 2 | 4 | 0 |
| [Choice](#choice) | `.choice, .choice__input` | core | Type, Checked, State | 12 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| [Chip](#chip) | `.chip` | core | Selected, State | 8 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| [Swatch](#swatch) | `.swatch` | core | Size, Selected, State | 12 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| [Badge](#badge) | `.badge` | core | Tone | 7 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| [Message](#message) | `.message` | core | Tone | 3 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| [Quantity Selector](#quantity) | `.qty` | secondary | State | 3 | 2 | 1 | 0 |
| [Rating](#rating) | `.rating` | secondary | Value | 6 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| [Accordion Item](#accordion-item) | `.accordion__item` | core | Open, State | 6 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| [Breadcrumb](#breadcrumb) | `.breadcrumb` | core | Layout | 2 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| [Pagination](#pagination) | `.pagination, .load-more, .pagination-switch` | core | Pattern, Load more state | 8 | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| [Drawer](#drawer) | `.drawer` | core | Presentation | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| [Product Card](#product-card) | `.product-card` | core | State | 3 | 4 | 4 | 1 |

**Naming and conventions.** Component names are Title Case; variant property names and values are Title Case (`State = Hover`); booleans start with `Show` or describe a toggle (`Removable`, `Sold out`); text properties are nouns (`Label`, `Title`). State is a **variant** because states change fills and strokes; optional parts are **booleans** because they only show or hide layers; swappable content (icons, images, slots) is an **instance swap**; copy is a **text** property.

**Icons.** One Icon component set (24px, stroke from icon/stroke) with one variant per icon; the Icon instance-swap property points at it. The web system has 24 icons in 05-Assets/Icons. Icons: account, arrow-left, arrow-right, bag, check-circle, check, chevron-down, chevron-left, chevron-right, chevron-up, close, eye-off, eye, filter, heart, info, location, menu, minus, plus, search, sort, star, warning.

## Button  <a id="button"></a>

Primary, secondary and text actions. The one component that carries most interactions.

- **Web equivalent:** `.btn, .btn--primary, .btn--secondary, .btn--text`
- **Text style:** Label/Button
- **Variants:** 3 x 3 x 5 = 45 variants. The state axis is a variant property (not a boolean) because each state changes fills and strokes.

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Variant | VARIANT | Primary, Secondary, Text | Primary | Visual hierarchy of the action |
| Size | VARIANT | Sm, Md, Lg | Md | Sm and Lg exist in the web system |
| State | VARIANT | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled | Default | Interactive states |
| Label | TEXT |  | Add to bag | Button label |
| Show leading icon | BOOLEAN |  | false | Icon before the label |
| Show trailing icon | BOOLEAN |  | false | Icon after the label |
| Icon | INSTANCE_SWAP |  | Icon/arrow-right | Swaps the icon shown in either slot |

**Auto Layout**

| Aspect | Specification |
|---|---|
| Direction | HORIZONTAL |
| Width | HUG (set to FILL on phones for primary actions) |
| Height | FIXED from {control/height/*} |
| Padding | {control/padding-x/*} left and right, 0 top and bottom |
| Gap | {button/gap} |
| Alignment | centre, centre |
| Minimum width | {touch-target/min} |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |
|---|---|---|
| frame | height | `control/height/md` |
| frame | cornerRadius | `radius/control` |
| frame | itemSpacing | `button/gap` |
| frame | minWidth | `touch-target/min` |
| frame | paddingLeft/Right | `control/padding-x/md` |
| icon | width/height | `icon/size/sm` |
| focus ring | strokeWeight | `focus/ring-width` |
| focus ring | offset | `focus/ring-offset` |
| focus ring | stroke | `color/focus/ring` |

**State styles** (variable bound to each state)

| Variant | State | Fill | Stroke | Stroke width | Text | Focus ring | Stroke style |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Variant=Primary | Default | `color/button/primary-bg` | none |  | `color/button/primary-text` |  |  |
| Variant=Secondary | Default | none | `color/button/secondary-border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/primary` |  |  |
| Variant=Text | Default | none | none |  | `color/link/default` |  |  |
| Variant=Primary | Hover | `color/button/primary-bg-hover` | none |  | `color/button/primary-text` |  |  |
| Variant=Secondary | Hover | `color/button/secondary-bg-hover` | `color/button/secondary-border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/button/secondary-text-hover` |  |  |
| Variant=Text | Hover | none | none |  | `color/link/hover` |  |  |
| Variant=Primary | Pressed | `color/button/primary-bg-active` | none |  | `color/button/primary-text` |  |  |
| Variant=Secondary | Pressed | `color/button/secondary-bg-hover` | `color/button/secondary-border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/button/secondary-text-hover` |  |  |
| Variant=Text | Pressed | none | none |  | `color/brand/primary-active` |  |  |
| Variant=Primary | Focus | `color/button/primary-bg` | none |  | `color/button/primary-text` | yes |  |
| Variant=Secondary | Focus | none | `color/button/secondary-border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/primary` | yes |  |
| Variant=Text | Focus | none | none |  | `color/link/default` | yes |  |
| Variant=Primary | Disabled | `color/button/disabled-bg` | none |  | `color/button/disabled-text` |  |  |
| Variant=Secondary | Disabled | `color/button/disabled-bg` | none |  | `color/button/disabled-text` |  |  |
| Variant=Text | Disabled | none | none |  | `color/text/disabled` |  |  |

**Responsive intent.** Width is Hug on tablet and desktop; on phones the primary action is usually Fill container (the web has .btn--block-mobile). Height does not change by tier.

**Accessibility.** Visual height 40, 48 or 56px; the 40px Sm button must keep a 44px hit area (place a transparent 44px frame behind it or add padding in the layout). Focus state shows a 2px ring with a 2px offset in color/focus/ring (color/focus/ring-inverse on the Inverse mode). The disabled label uses color/button/disabled-text on color/button/disabled-bg; disabled controls are exempt from contrast rules but stay legible.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to .btn with .btn--primary, .btn--secondary or .btn--text and .btn--sm or .btn--lg. Use aria-disabled rather than disabled when focus must stay (loading). The web has no button loading state yet (open finding); do not design one here without approval.

**Not representable in Figma:** aria-busy and loading (not designed in the web system); real keyboard focus order.

## Icon Button  <a id="icon-button"></a>

Icon-only actions (search, account, bag, wishlist, close).

- **Web equivalent:** `.icon-btn`
- **Text style:** Label/Utility
- **Variants:** 5 x 2 = 10 variants.

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| State | VARIANT | Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled | Default |  |
| Selected | VARIANT | false, true | false | Pressed toggle, for example the wishlist heart (filled icon) |
| Icon | INSTANCE_SWAP |  | Icon/search | Which icon |
| Show count | BOOLEAN |  | false | Count bubble, for the bag |
| Count | TEXT |  | 2 | Number inside the bubble |
| Accessible name | TEXT |  | Search | aria-label for developers; not visible |

| Width | FIXED {touch-target/min} |

| Padding | centred icon |

| Element | Property | Variable |

## Input Field  <a id="input-field"></a>

Label, control, hint and message for text, select and textarea.

- **Web equivalent:** `.field, .input, .select, .textarea`
- **Text style:** Form/Input (value), Label/Default (label), Body/Small (hint), Form/Validation (error)
- **Variants:** 3 x 4 = 12 variants.

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Type | VARIANT | Text, Select, Textarea | Text |  |
| State | VARIANT | Default, Focus, Error, Disabled | Default |  |
| Label | TEXT |  | Email | Always visible; no placeholder-only fields |
| Value | TEXT |  |  | Content or placeholder |
| Hint | TEXT |  |  | Helper text |
| Error message | TEXT |  | Enter a valid email | Shown in the Error state |
| Show hint | BOOLEAN |  | false |  |
| Required | BOOLEAN |  | false | Adds the required marker to the label |

**Auto Layout**

| Aspect | Specification |
|---|---|
| Direction | VERTICAL |
| Width | FILL |
| Height | HUG (control FIXED {control/height/md}; textarea min {input/textarea-min-height}) |
| Padding | {input/padding-x} left and right, {input/padding-y} top and bottom inside the control |
| Gap | {form/label-gap} between label and control |
| Alignment | start |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |
|---|---|---|
| control | height | `control/height/md` |
| control | cornerRadius | `radius/control` |
| control | paddingLeft/Right | `input/padding-x` |
| control | paddingTop/Bottom | `input/padding-y` |
| field | itemSpacing | `form/label-gap` |
| textarea | minHeight | `input/textarea-min-height` |

**State styles** (variable bound to each state)

| Variant | State | Fill | Stroke | Stroke width | Text | Focus ring | Stroke style |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| State=Default | Default | `color/control/bg` | `color/control/border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/primary` |  |  |
| State=Focus | Focus | `color/control/bg` | `color/control/border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/primary` | yes |  |
| State=Error | Error | `color/control/bg` | `color/status/error` | `border-width/thick` | `color/text/primary` |  |  |
| State=Disabled | Disabled | `color/bg/subtle` | `color/control/border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/disabled` |  | dashed |

**Responsive intent.** Fill width; two fields may sit side by side from the Tablet mode (the web uses .grid--2 from 600px).

**Accessibility.** The value text style is 16px (Form/Input) so iOS does not zoom on focus. An error is shown by a thicker error-coloured border plus an icon plus text, never colour alone. Control borders use color/control/border (3:1 or more on ivory and white); do not place a control directly on color/bg/subtle (2.8:1).

**Developer handoff.** Maps to .field with .input, .select or .textarea; errors link through aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

**Not representable in Figma:** browser-native select and date pickers; live validation timing.

| frame | itemSpacing | `space/2` |

| Variant | State | Fill | Stroke | Stroke width | Text | Focus ring | Stroke style |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Selected=false | Default | `color/control/bg` | `color/control/border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/primary` |  |  |
| Selected=false | Hover | `color/control/bg` | `color/control/border-hover` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/primary` |  |  |
| Selected=false | Focus | `color/control/bg` | `color/control/border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/primary` | yes |  |
| Selected=false | Disabled | `color/bg/subtle` | `color/control/border` | `border-width/thin` | `color/text/disabled` |  | dashed |
| Selected=true | Default | `color/brand/tint` | `color/brand/primary` | `border-width/thick` | `color/brand/primary-active` |  |  |
| Selected=true | Hover | `color/brand/tint` | `color/brand/primary` | `border-width/thick` | `color/brand/primary-active` |  |  |
| Selected=true | Focus | `color/brand/tint` | `color/brand/primary` | `border-width/thick` | `color/brand/primary-active` | yes |  |
| Selected=true | Disabled | `color/bg/subtle` | `color/control/border` | `border-width/thick` | `color/text/disabled` |  | dashed |

**Responsive intent.** On phones the choice row is a single horizontally scrolling line of chips (approved web decision 2): build it as an Auto Layout row with clipping on and padding above and below so the focus ring is not cut. From Tablet it wraps. Applied filters always wrap.

**Accessibility.** Visual height 40px with a 44px hit area (add a transparent 44px frame). Selected is a tint plus a check mark plus a 2px border. A chip cut off at the row edge signals that the row scrolls.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to .chip with aria-pressed; the scrolling row is .chip-row with chip-row.js, which keeps a focused chip fully visible.

**Not representable in Figma:** horizontal scrolling and scroll-into-view on focus (prototype with a scrolling frame to show intent).

## Swatch  <a id="swatch"></a>

Shade and colour chooser; the colour is product data.

- **Web equivalent:** `.swatch`
- **Text style:** Body/Small
- **Variants:** 2 x 2 x 3 = 12 variants. The swatch fill is a per-instance override of product data, deliberately NOT a variable (as in the web system, where it is an inline --swatch property).

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Size | VARIANT | Md, Sm | Md | Sm is the decorative mini swatch on cards (not interactive) |
| Selected | VARIANT | false, true | false | Selected draws a 2px ring with an offset |
| State | VARIANT | Default, Focus, Disabled | Default | Disabled shows a diagonal strike |
| Shade name | TEXT |  | Rosewood | Displayed next to the group, not inside the swatch |

**Auto Layout**

| Aspect | Specification |
|---|---|
| Direction | HORIZONTAL |
| Width | FIXED {swatch/size} |
| Height | FIXED {swatch/size} |
| Padding | 0 |
| Gap | {swatch/ring-offset} |
| Alignment | centre |
| Minimum width | {touch-target/min} hit area for Md |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |
|---|---|---|
| chip | width/height | `swatch/size` |
| mini chip | width/height | `swatch/size-sm` |
| ring | strokeWeight | `swatch/ring-width` |
| ring | offset | `swatch/ring-offset` |
| ring | stroke | `color/text/primary` |

**Responsive intent.** Same at every size.

**Accessibility.** The selection ring (not the swatch colour) carries the 3:1 requirement, and the selected shade name is displayed as text.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to .swatch with --swatch set inline from product data.

**Not representable in Figma:** real product colours; radio-group keyboard behaviour (arrow keys).

| Label | TEXT |  | New |  |

| Height | HUG |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |

| frame | cornerRadius | `radius/badge` |
| frame | fill (Brand) | `color/brand/primary` |
| text (Brand) | fill | `color/text/on-brand` |
| frame | fill (Dark) | `color/bg/inverse` |
| text (Dark) | fill | `color/text/inverse` |

**Developer handoff.** Maps to .badge with .badge--brand, --dark, --outline, --success, --warning, --error.

**Responsive intent.** Same at every size.

**Accessibility.** The stars are one image in the web implementation, named like "Rated 4 out of 5"; the filled and empty stars also differ by fill shape, not only colour.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to .rating with a role="img" label.

**Not representable in Figma:** role="img" label.

---

## Accordion Item  <a id="accordion-item"></a>

A disclosure row; several can be open at once (approved web decision 3).

- **Web equivalent:** `.accordion__item`
- **Text style:** Heading/H5 (title), Body/Default (content)
- **Variants:** 2 x 3 = 6 variants. Rows are independent; there is no exclusive group in Figma either.

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open | VARIANT | false, true | false | Chevron rotates when open |
| State | VARIANT | Default, Hover, Focus | Default |  |
| Title | TEXT |  | Key ingredients |  |
| Content | INSTANCE_SWAP |  | Content/Text block | Slot for the panel content |

**Auto Layout**

| Aspect | Specification |
|---|---|
| Direction | VERTICAL |
| Width | FILL |
| Height | HUG |
| Padding | summary row at least {touch-target/min} high; panel padding {space/5} bottom |
| Gap | 0 |
| Alignment | start |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |
|---|---|---|
| summary | minHeight | `touch-target/min` |
| summary | stroke (bottom) | `color/border/subtle` |
| chevron | width/height | `icon/size/md` |
| panel | paddingBottom | `space/5` |
| panel | maxWidth | `layout/container/text` |

**Responsive intent.** Fill width; the panel is capped at the reading measure.

**Accessibility.** The whole summary row is the target (44px or more). Open and closed are shown by the chevron and the content, not colour.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to native details and summary. Do not add a name attribute (exclusive behaviour) unless a documented use case needs it.

**Not representable in Figma:** native details toggling.

---

## Breadcrumb  <a id="breadcrumb"></a>

Trail to the current page.

- **Web equivalent:** `.breadcrumb`
- **Text style:** Body/Small
- **Variants:** 2 variants. Place Breadcrumb in the Mobile mode frame with Layout = Compact, in Tablet and Desktop with Layout = Full.

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Layout | VARIANT | Full, Compact | Full | Compact is the phone pattern: parent plus current page on one line, the current page truncated (approved web decision 1) |
| Items | TEXT |  | Home / Skincare / Serums / Rosewater Barrier Serum | Documentation of the trail; build real items from Breadcrumb Item instances |
| Truncate current | BOOLEAN |  | true | Ellipsis on the last item (Compact) |

**Auto Layout**

| Aspect | Specification |
|---|---|
| Direction | HORIZONTAL |
| Width | FILL |
| Height | HUG, minimum {touch-target/min} |
| Padding | 0 |
| Gap | {space/2} |
| Alignment | start, centre |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |
|---|---|---|
| item | minHeight | `touch-target/min` |
| row | itemSpacing | `space/2` |
| separator | width/height | `icon/size/sm` |
| separator | fill | `color/text/muted` |
| link | fill | `color/text/secondary` |
| current | fill | `color/text/primary` |

**Responsive intent.** Compact below the Tablet tier, Full from Tablet. Compact hides the ancestors above the parent (they are also absent from the accessibility tree on phones: an open point for screen-reader testing).

**Accessibility.** Each link keeps a 44px target. The current page is plain text, not a link style.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to nav.breadcrumb with an ordered list; the phone behaviour is CSS only in the web system.

**Not representable in Figma:** the hidden ancestors on phones.

---

## Pagination  <a id="pagination"></a>

Numbered pagination (tablet and desktop) and Load more (phones). PROVISIONAL: nothing is verified against Shopify.

- **Web equivalent:** `.pagination, .load-more, .pagination-switch`
- **Text style:** Label/Default (page numbers), Body/Caption (status)
- **Variants:** 2 patterns; Load more has 4 states (Load more reuses Button and Message instances). 2 + 4 = 6 variants, not 8: Numbered has no loading states.

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pattern | VARIANT | Numbered, Load more | Numbered | Load more is the phone pattern; Numbered the tablet and desktop pattern |
| Load more state | VARIANT | Default, Loading, Error, Done | Default | Only used when Pattern = Load more |
| Status text | TEXT |  | Showing 24 of 96 products | Announced politely in the web implementation |
| Current page | TEXT |  | 1 | Numbered only |

**Auto Layout**

| Aspect | Specification |
|---|---|
| Direction | HORIZONTAL (Numbered), VERTICAL (Load more) |
| Width | FILL |
| Height | HUG |
| Padding | 0 |
| Gap | {space/1} between page links; {space/3} in Load more |
| Alignment | centre, centre |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |
|---|---|---|
| page link | width/height (min) | `touch-target/min` |
| row | itemSpacing | `space/1` |
| load more | itemSpacing | `space/3` |
| current page | fill | `color/button/primary-bg` |
| current page | text | `color/button/primary-text` |
| disabled link | text | `color/text/muted` |
| load more error | fill | `color/status/error-bg` |

**Responsive intent.** Load more on Mobile frames, Numbered from Tablet. A phone in landscape (600px or wider) gets the Numbered pattern.

**Accessibility.** Page links keep 44px targets; the current page is a fill plus bold text, not colour alone. Loading is announced and focus stays on the button in the web implementation.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to .pagination-switch (CSS shows one pattern), .load-more and load-more.js. Real URLs (?page=N) must stay as links. Recovery from a mid-list URL (Load previous) is NOT designed because it is undecided (web foundations.md section 14, risk A).

**Not representable in Figma:** URL synchronisation, reload, shared links, back and forward, scroll restoration (all unverified in the web system); focus moving to the first new item.

---

## Drawer  <a id="drawer"></a>

Filter and sort panel: a full-width sheet on phones, a 416px side panel from tablet (approved web decision 5).

- **Web equivalent:** `.drawer`
- **Text style:** Heading/H5 (title)
- **Variants:** 2 variants. Contains instances of Icon Button, Button and Choice.

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Presentation | VARIANT | Sheet, Panel | Sheet | Sheet = Mobile; Panel = Tablet and Desktop |
| Title | TEXT |  | Filters | Becomes the dialog name |
| Body | INSTANCE_SWAP |  | Content/Filter options | Scrolling content slot |
| Primary action | TEXT |  | Show 24 products | Pinned footer action |
| Show footer | BOOLEAN |  | true |  |
| Show scrim | BOOLEAN |  | true | Scrim beside the Panel (the Sheet covers the viewport) |

**Auto Layout**

| Aspect | Specification |
|---|---|
| Direction | VERTICAL |
| Width | Sheet: FILL the viewport; Panel: FIXED {layout/drawer-width} |
| Height | FILL the viewport |
| Padding | head {space/1} {space/1} {space/1} {space/4}; body {space/3} {space/4}; footer {space/4} |
| Gap | 0 (head, body and footer are separate regions; only the body scrolls) |
| Alignment | start |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |
|---|---|---|
| panel | width (Panel) | `layout/drawer-width` |
| panel | fill | `color/bg/surface` |
| scrim | fill | `color/overlay/scrim` |
| head | stroke (bottom) | `color/border/subtle` |
| footer | stroke (top) | `color/border/subtle` |
| close button | width/height | `touch-target/min` |
| body | paddingLeft/Right | `space/4` |
| footer | padding | `space/4` |

**Responsive intent.** Sheet in the Mobile mode, Panel in Tablet and Desktop. The Layout collection variable layout/drawer-width is reference-only on Mobile (the sheet fills the screen).

**Accessibility.** A close button (44px) and a pinned primary action are always visible. In the web implementation the drawer is a modal dialog with a focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus restore; Figma shows none of that, so document it on the component and test it in a browser.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to dialog.drawer with drawer.js. aria-labelledby points at the title.

**Not representable in Figma:** focus trap, Escape, background scroll lock, focus restore (implemented and tested in Chromium only; manual tests pending).

---

## Product Card  <a id="product-card"></a>

Collection and search result card: image, badges, wishlist, brand, title, rating, price, swatches, quick action.

- **Web equivalent:** `.product-card`
- **Text style:** Product/Title, Product/Price, Label/Overline (brand), Body/Caption
- **Variants:** 3 variants plus booleans for optional parts. No combinatorial explosion: optionality is booleans, not variants.

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| State | VARIANT | Default, Hover, Focus | Default | Hover zooms the image slightly on pointer devices only |
| Sold out | BOOLEAN |  | false | Muted image plus a Sold out badge; the action becomes disabled |
| Image | INSTANCE_SWAP |  | Image/Product 4:5 | The 4:5 canvas is the PROVISIONAL default (no real photography yet) |
| Show badge | BOOLEAN |  | false |  |
| Show rating | BOOLEAN |  | true |  |
| Show swatches | BOOLEAN |  | false |  |
| Brand | TEXT |  | NUDGE |  |
| Title | TEXT |  | Rosewater Barrier Serum |  |
| Price | TEXT |  | $48.00 |  |
| Compare price | TEXT |  | $58.00 | Struck through when present |

**Auto Layout**

| Aspect | Specification |
|---|---|
| Direction | VERTICAL |
| Width | FILL (grid cell) |
| Height | HUG |
| Padding | 0 (the image is flush) |
| Gap | {product-card/gap} |
| Alignment | start |

**Variable bindings**

| Element | Property | Variable |
|---|---|---|
| card | itemSpacing | `product-card/gap` |
| image | cornerRadius | `radius/card` |
| image | fill (placeholder) | `color/bg/subtle` |
| badges | offset | `product-card/badge-offset` |
| wishlist | width/height | `touch-target/min` |
| swatches | width/height | `swatch/size-sm` |
| sale price | fill | `color/price/sale` |
| focus ring (whole card) | stroke | `color/focus/ring` |

**Responsive intent.** Placed in a 2, 3 or 4 column grid from the Layout modes (gutter and gap follow the mode). A phone card is 129 to 136px wide at 320px (171px at 390px): the badge area reserves room for the 44px wishlist button and the badge label wraps.

**Accessibility.** One link target (the title); the whole card shows the focus ring where the browser supports :has(), otherwise the title link shows it. Do not place text directly on photography without a solid panel or scrim.

**Developer handoff.** Maps to .product-card; the image is a .ratio frame (4:5 provisional). Hover zoom is a prototype interaction only.

**Not representable in Figma:** real photography (none supplied): crop, focal point and packaging visibility are awaiting representative assets; hover zoom timing.

---

## Patterns

| Pattern | Built from | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Filter row | Chip | Choice chips scroll horizontally on Mobile and wrap from Tablet; applied-filter chips always wrap. |
| Product grid | Product Card, Pagination | 2, 3 or 4 columns from the Layout modes; Load more on Mobile, Numbered from Tablet. |
| Filter drawer | Drawer, Choice, Button | Sheet on Mobile, Panel from Tablet; the footer action shows the result count. |
| Product detail information | Accordion Item, Rating, Swatch, Quantity Selector, Button | Accordion rows open independently. |

## Deliberately not components

- Header, navigation, mobile menu, footer (page sections, not in the web system yet)
- Toast and cart drawer content (deferred in the web system)
- Tabs, search with suggestions, skeleton loaders (not needed or Shopify features)
